messages:
maria: Heads-up — postmortem follow-ups from last night's KV OOM run. Putting a short docket here so we can assign owners and timelines. TL;DR: recurring small-residency growth + slab fragmentation. Need profiling, temporary soft-limits, and a GC/canary plan.

devin: +1. can we get an initial profiling artifact? last heap profile looked noisy. I kicked off a pprof run on the failing shard group at 03:40 UTC (link: https://dash.redwood/pprof/2901239876).

ashok: saw that. pprof shows a steady kv-residency bump tied to checkpoint processing (/persist/flush). suspect a retention hiccup in the slab allocator.
maria: Action 1 — deep profile and allocation attribution. Owner: @devin. Target: get flamegraphs + aggregated hotspot table by Wed EOD.

devin: Ack — I'll gather pprof + jemalloc stats. Command I ran: 
```
pprof -proto http://prod-shard-12:6060/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/pprof_shard12.pb
go tool pprof -http=:8080 /bin/engine /tmp/pprof_shard12.pb
```
Will upload snapshots to the deck.

ashok: Action 2 — test soft eviction guard. Owner: @ashok. Add a softlimit that triggers eviction early (70% of RLIMIT) to avoid abrupt OOM. Plan: add config flag kv.soft_eviction_pct and roll a canary to one host class. ETA: Fri.

lina: Action 3 — slab compaction experiment. Owner: @lina. Try compaction sweep every 30m (instead of 6h) on canary and measure fragmentation metric (alloc-frag-ratio). Need perf baseline first. ETA: next Tue.

maria: Action 4 — GC tuning for background frees. Owner: @jordan. Propose increasing background free workers from 2 -> 6 and enabling incremental free pass on idle. Canary rollout to 3 machines, monitor latency tail. ETA: 48h for canary.

jordan: I'll open the rollout PR with the config diff. Sample snippet: 
```
# runtime config
mem.background_free_workers: 6
mem.incremental_free: true
```
Also will add an emergency rollback script.

devin: Also recommending a tracing instrumentation: tag requests that touch large-range snapshots so we can correlate long-lived kv handles to request types. Owner: @devin (same as profiling).

maria: Ownership + timeline summary:
- Profiling & flamegraphs — devin — Wed EOD
- Soft-eviction feature canary — ashok — Fri (canary)
- Slab compaction cadence test — lina — next Tue
- GC background tuning canary — jordan — 48h

maria: Recurrences & detection: add an alert for "kv_residency_trend" (3m slope > 1MB/min for 15m) and link to new runbook. If that alert fires 3 times in 24h, auto-open a P1 incident. Owner: maria -> will add alert by EOD.

alloc-bot: reminder: scheduled jemalloc metrics retention job runs at 04:00 UTC daily; last run completed in 00.8s.

ashok: Quick question — can we load a patched allocator in canary without restart? If not, plan needs short maintenance window.

lina: For slab compaction I need a restart for the sweep binary. We should schedule it during low-traffic window (03:00-04:30 UTC).

maria: OK — coordination notes:
- devs please drop artifacts (pprof, jemalloc stats, logs) into /shared/memory-siege/2901239876 by EOD Wed.
- ashok/lina/jordan: target canary completions on their ETAs and post results with the key metrics: alloc-frag-ratio, residency-growth-rate, 95/99p latency.

devin: Putting a short checklist in the doc:
- [ ] pprof snapshots uploaded
- [ ] flamegraphs linked
- [ ] jemalloc stats for canary
- [ ] soft-eviction config diff + canary rollout notes
- [ ] compaction runner logs
- [ ] GC rollout + latency dashboard panels

maria: We'll reconvene Fri 14:00 UTC for a live sync to decide next steps after the canary results. If any canary shows regression, rollback immediately and paste the rollback command in this thread.

ashok: noted. starting soft-eviction branch now. ping here when canary is up. :spiral_note_pad:

lina: I'll schedule the compaction window and post in #eng-oncall so ops is aware.

jordan: PR ready, marking it as draft until we have metrics hooks.

maria: thanks everyone — this thread is the single source for owners/timelines. if you take ownership, mention it here so it's clear.

devin: owning profiling bits, will post artifacts shortly.

ashok: owning soft-eviction canary, ETA Fri morning.

lina: owning compaction test and scheduling.

jordan: owning GC canary rollout.

maria: added follow-up: plan a 2-week retro after the mitigations are stable to capture recurrence patterns and long-term guardrails.

alloc-bot: notice: creating folder /shared/memory-siege/2901239876 for uploads.
